items.title: The impact that AI will have on advertising, according to Sir Martin Sorrell

items.title: Adobe Expects Record U.S. Holiday Online Shopping This Year
items.summary: Adobe’s analytics division projected $275.1 billion in U.S. online sales between Nov. 1 and Dec. 31, up 6.7% from the same period last year.

items.title: Consumer AI use a boon for the holidays as AI traffic doubles
items.summary: Consumers using AI engage with brands’ offers at a higher rate than non-AI traffic and generate more revenue per visit, a survey from Adobe found.
